This body path is proven; do not infer all text entrypoints or each LINE/PAGE invokes it. Current entry is hooked, so a concrete consumer claim must retain caller/hook ownership.
proven_native_contract.glyph: Proportional path subtracts float32(scale*left) from pen at2a3f04..14; later adds float32(scale*max(22,left+ink+3)) at2a4190..a4. Separate source-order rounding and incomingpen matter. Current Advances stores only collapsed integer net, losing the subtract/add decomposition. A specialglyph loaded from488e5c skips22floor; source-specific formula must retain that exception.
proven_native_contract.bearing_mode: 1800/2000 clear/set contextbyte+1 bit0x02. That bit changes bearing subtraction and final advance branch; scale alone is not enough for every label. Current stream init sets proportional mode, but later controls can change it.
proven_native_contract.space: Existing guarded SPACE opcodes select14.0f. Actual representative2a526c..88 loads scale, multiplies14*scale, adds to pen+3c. SPACE0 is a special path, not ordinary metric-row0.
proven_native_contract.LINE: LINE captures current scale and computes penY+=30*scale at2a2ca8..2a2cc0. Center/right horizontal-alignment paths scan future words through2a2a60 mode1; those scans can execute future scale controls. Examined LINE body does not reset+44.
proven_native_contract.PAGE: PAGE performs width lookahead and separate vertical centering/cvt.w.s arithmetic. It is not a new-stream1.0 reset. Scaled rowcount is not a complete height/centering model.
proven_native_contract.HDR: Exact HDR handler2a3060..6c does not reset+44. Never invent a reset on2800.
proven_native_contract.negative_offset: C000..C7FF adds sign-extended11-bit X displacement directly, unscaled, at2a3270..9c. Positive glyphscale can still place tileorigin left of pen through bearing subtraction. Pen displacement is not ink span; keep absolute/negative-position controls held.
proven_native_contract.bounded_numbers: 7000 reaches shared formatter;2a37c4 temporarily sets cellfield+8 to21 and2a37dc calls nested2a38f0 using same context, then restorescell. Existing integer digit bounds do not independently prove scaled numeric/position behavior; first prefix-only subset excludes numeric/nested params.

stable_leading_subset.candidate: One explicit positive scale before any visible content, immutable thereafter. Reject repeated/midstream/reset scale tokens initially; literalglyphs/SPACE and neutralcolors only, no center/position/spacing-mode/nested/number/icon controls. Source-pinned proportional streaming context; single line with wrapdisabled is smallest numerical proof.
stable_leading_subset.reuse: controls can own prefix parsing and one immutable scale, then existing wrapPages can pass that data to its existing controls atom scans. No second scale interpreter, helper or general state engine is needed. encode and previewFit retain their current responsibilities.
stable_leading_subset.rounding_problem: Zero-origin atom widths plus SPACE are not exactly additive under source per-glyph float32 subtract/add. Even a stable prefix does not justify summing rounded atom widths or multiplying collapsed Advances and calling that native-exact.
stable_leading_subset.safe_future_direction: For native acceptance, remeasure complete candidate lines from an agreed origin with existing controls, or prove a conservative source-operation/composition error envelope. inspect may expose raw metrics already read. Do not create another font parser or formatter.
stable_leading_subset.no_feature_now: Do not add a nominal scaled-unit feature without a concrete needed consumer, and do not blur native units to claim coverage. Existing profiles and strict planner acceptance remain unchanged.

Name budget units/baseline and derive a compatible consumer bound. Current398/530 are declared unscaled advance limits, not screenpixels; multiplying either without its baseline is unsupported.
